about: Works, tools and classes that run on open-audiovisual. One entry per work; add yours with a pull request to this file or with the issue form (CONTRIBUTING.md, 'Tell us what you made'). Every entry is here because the person who made the work asked for it.

works.title: The Last Input
works.en: A 14-scene performance made during a C-LAB Taiwan Sound Lab / IRCAM residency and played on a 49.4-channel speaker dome. The core of open-audiovisual was taken out of this show: its timeline, chord semantics, MIDI learn and OSC batching ran here first.
works.zh: C-LAB 臺灣聲響實驗室與 IRCAM 駐村期間做的十四個場景的演出，在 49.4 聲道的球型音場裡演。open-audiovisual 的核心是從這場演出抽出來的，時間軸、和弦語意、MIDI learn 和 OSC 批次傳送都是先在這裡跑過。

works.title: cheyuwu-lab
works.en: A studio of generative sketches where every sketch can be played from a controller, a phone or a hand. Its controllers, instruments, drum machine and recorder are open-audiovisual packages, rebuilt from the framework every night.
works.zh: 一間放生成作品的實驗室，每件作品都能用控制器、手機或手來彈。裡面的控制器、樂器、鼓機和錄影都是 open-audiovisual 的套件，每天晚上從框架重新產生一次。
